title: The Toy Chicken
setting: A cosy family kitchen with a fireplace on Christmas morning.

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, his mother with long black hair and a green apron

sentences.en: On Christmas morning, Sam hears a terrible sound.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节早上，萨姆听到一个可怕的声音。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt covers his ears in a hallway decorated for Christmas, looking toward the kitchen.

sentences.en: Someone is in the kitchen near the fire.
sentences.zh: 有人在厨房里，就在炉火旁边。
sentences.scene_prompt: A shadowy figure stands near a warm fireplace in a kitchen while Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt peeks around the door.

sentences.en: His mother Mia holds a single toy chicken.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈米娅手里拿着一只玩具鸡。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, his mother with long black hair and a green apron holds up one yellow toy chicken, squeezing it, near the fireplace.

sentences.en: The poor boy laughs and hugs the toy.
sentences.zh: 可怜的小男孩笑了，抱住了玩具。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt laughs with relief and hugs the yellow toy chicken.

sentences.en: It is hard, but he loves it so much.
sentences.zh: 它硬邦邦的，但他非常喜欢它。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt taps the hard plastic toy chicken and smiles widely.

sentences.en: Of all his gifts, he likes it most.
sentences.zh: 在所有礼物里，他最喜欢它。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt sits among opened Christmas gifts, holding the toy chicken above the others.

sentences.en: "Please drink your milk now," says Mia.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, his mother with long black hair and a green apron hands a glass of milk to Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt, who still holds the toy chicken.
